subject: Approvals: Summer intern retention & conversion to new-grad headcount
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Interns: recommended return offers + headcount ask

Hi team,

I've completed performance calibrations for the summer SWE interns and want to request approvals to convert two of them to new-grad full-time headcount and to extend a return-offer to one continuing intern. Quick summary: 

- Alex Zhou (SWE Intern, backend services) — strong contributor, risk of attrition; recommend conversion to New Grad SWE (start Aug 2026). Proposed comp: Base $140,000 + $20k sign-on + 0.5% eq (standard new-grad band for SWE-IC). Resume attached.
- Jordan Kim (SWE Intern, infra) — solid, recommend standard new-grad offer: Base $135,000 + $10k sign-on + 0.4% eq.
- Candidate (return intern): Maria Alvarez — recommend extend return-offer for another internship cycle (June–Aug) at same stipend.

Headcount impact: convert 2 intern slots to 2 FTE (new-grads) effective FY26 Q3; retain 1 intern slot for summer program. This will draw from the Allocated Engineering headcount pool (REQ-4521).

Attachments: candidate_resume_alex_zhou.pdf, comp_band_chart_q1_2026.xlsx, 2026_intern_offer_template.pdf

Ask: 1) Evelyn/Monica — confirm comp band alignment and legal/HR approvals. 2) Laura — final sign-off on headcount conversion and any adjustments to comp for retention. Please advise by EOD Thu 2/12 so we can meet campus recruiting timelines.

Thanks,
Dev
Dev Patel
Sr. Eng. Manager, Core Services
Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interns: recommended return offers + headcount ask

Thanks Dev — I reviewed the calibrations and bands. A few notes: 

- Alex's performance warrants an above-band retention adjustment; the proposed base of $140k sits at top of band for L3 SWE. If retention risk is high, we can approve up to $150k with an increased sign-on as a one-time retention bonus.
- Jordan fits comfortably within the standard new-grad band ($130–138k); $135k is fine.
- For Maria (intern return), please use the attached intern-stipend template; no HC change required.

Monica — please prep the HC transfer ticket to move 2 FTEs into Eng-Alloc (REQ-4521) and attach comp_band_chart_q1_2026.xlsx. Laura — looping you for headcount and any budget questions.

Best,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Head of Recruiting
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Interns: recommended return offers + headcount ask

+1 on Alex — losing him is a real risk. He’s taken ownership of the microservices migration and is the only intern comfortably shipping on the critical path. Happy to justify the $150k ask — he'll unblock a lot of near-term delivery.

Budget note: If Laura okays the bump, I recommend we mark $20k of the sign-on as a retention payout contingent on 12-month service. That keeps the recurring base within band while addressing immediate retention.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Manager, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: HC request created + offer templates attached (REQ-4521)

Hi Laura — per the thread above I've opened the headcount request REQ-4521 to convert 2 intern slots to 2 FTE (New Grad SWE) and retain 1 intern slot. Links and docs attached.

Attachments: 2026_intern_offer_template.pdf, comp_band_chart_q1_2026.xlsx
HC request: https://dash.redwood.ai/hc-requests/REQ-4521
DocuSign draft (internal): https://www.docusign.com/rs/offer/draft-REQ-4521

Please review and approve the HC transfer and the two offer packages. If approved, Monica/Recruiting will generate DocuSign offers and route to candidates (Alex first) for signature.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Feb 2026 10:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: HC request created + offer templates attached (REQ-4521)

Thanks all — reviewed REQ-4521 and the candidate notes. Approving the headcount conversion and offers with one change for retention: 

- Alex Zhou: approve conversion to New Grad SWE. Adjusted compensation: Base $150,000 + $20,000 sign-on (with $10k paid up front and $10k vested after 12 months) + 0.5% equity. Please include a 12-month retention clause in the offer.
- Jordan Kim: approve at Base $135,000 + $10,000 sign-on + 0.4% equity.
- Maria Alvarez: approve return internship stipend as proposed.

Monica — please update the DocuSign drafts and the HC request. Mark region = us for payroll setup. Once updated, route offers to candidates. Consider expediting Alex's offer to reduce counteroffer risk; recommend 24–48 hour turnaround.

Approving against Hiring budget: Eng-Alloc FY26 Q3. Laura Bennett (approve).

Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Alex Zhou <alex.zhou+offer@gmail.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Final: Offers approved and sent (Alex first) — DocuSign link

All — final confirmation. Laura's approvals are recorded on REQ-4521 and the comp adjustments have been applied to the drafts. I've sent the DocuSign offer to Alex (alex.zhou+offer@gmail.com) with the terms Laura approved. Link to the candidate-facing envelope: https://www.docusign.com/rs/offer/alex-zhou-sign

Next steps:
- Alex: please review and sign within 48 hours. Monica will coordinate start paperwork after signature.
- Dev/Marcus: once signed, recruiting will convert the HC in the payroll system and set tentative start date (early Aug 2026).

Attachments: candidate_resume_alex_zhou.pdf (for record)

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference
